voice.preset_note: 可選：填 grok 內建音色名（如 "eve"），每段都用同一個聲音，提示詞改用 <AUDIO_0>、不再用 desc。可用的名字見 references/voice.md。null = 按 desc 由 grok 自己配音
voice.alt_clone: MiMo mimo-v2.5-tts-voiceclone，參照用 3 段 Grok 口播拼的 ≥12 秒乾聲（見 references/voice.md）

tts_ref.text: Right, What first is, I would say……兩岸關係越緊張、越艱困，越需要溝通跟交流，so that's why…… 生生喝鮮奶、免費營養午餐
tts_ref.note: comfy 後端配音（scripts/tts_generate.py）克隆的參考音檔和它的逐字稿。倉庫裡沒有這個檔案：放 10–30 秒本人或明確授權的乾淨朗讀。2026-10-29 測試用的是 grok luna 的 10 秒試拍音軌，拿 AI 成品當克隆參考是否合乎服務條款沒查，正式發布前換成授權錄音。

model.name: grok-imagine-video-1.5
model.allowance_note: 佔 grok 每週額度的百分比。2026-10-26 實測（X Premium+）：3 段共 28 秒 720p 用掉 7–9%（/usage 只顯示整數）。480p 未實測。

comfy.note: 另一個後端：ComfyUI 上的 MiniMax H3（scripts/comfy_generate.py，build_tasks.py --backend comfy）。鎖住每段給的音軌、只生成畫面，提示詞用 h3_prompt_template（不寫台詞，寫了會燒字幕）。url 是內網 aikol，環境變數 COMFY_URL 優先。2026-10-27 用 10Eros 社群合併版實測（RTX 3090 Ti）：576×1024、10 秒一段約 186 秒；換官方權重就改下面的檔名，耗時和畫質要重測。
comfy.lead_in_note: 每段音軌前墊幾幀靜音，生成後連同畫面剪掉（6 幀 = 0.25 秒）。H3 開頭 1–3 幀會從參考圖跳成它自己畫的臉，不墊的話段和段接縫處會閃一下；直接剪開頭又會剪掉第一個字。0 = 不墊。錨點模式不墊（第一幀本來就是 H3 畫的臉），只有普通模式和建錨點庫那一次用。
comfy.anchors_note: 錨點模式（2026-10-31 新聞棚實測）：這位主播有錨點庫 assets/anchors/<參考圖檔名>/（home.png、a1.png…）時，comfy_generate.py 每段的第一幀和最後一幀都用庫裡的幀，接縫兩邊同一張，每個接縫輪流換一張。實測四個接縫頭的位置差 ≤ 0.9 px、亮度差 ≤ 0.8（普通模式頭會跳 4–20 px）。用「上一段最後一幀當下一段第一幀」接力會一段段變暗（H3 每生成一次暗約 6），所以錨點都從同一次普通模式的結果裡挑，不從上一段接。第一次用這位主播：先 --no-anchors 生成到別的目錄，make_anchors.py 建庫，sheet.jpg 給使用者看過再正式生成；之後的片子直接用。代價：錨點段要拍到最後一幀，整段保留，H3 每段至少 124 幀（約 5.2 秒），短句說完後會停將近 1 秒；使用者比較過加速尾巴的版本，選了不加速。錨點庫只放本機。
comfy.eye_warp_note: assemble.py 拼完全是 H3 的片子後逐幀把眼高壓成幾倍（只壓垂直方向，見 scripts/warp_eyes.py），1 = 不縮。H3 會把眼睛畫圓：新聞棚中景實測眼高÷兩眼距離比 grok 高 6–15%，換權重、縮小參考圖的眼睛、修臉節點都壓不住；0.8 壓到跟 grok 差 3% 以內。0.8 只在新聞棚主播上校準過，換主播或構圖先看一段再定。

colab.note: scripts/colab_h3.py 用：沒有自己的 GPU 時，在 Google Colab 的 G4（RTX PRO 6000，96 GB）上開機、裝 ComfyUI（釘 comfyui_commit）、從這裡的地址下載模型、生成、關機一條龍。事前 uv tool install google-colab-cli 並在終端跑一次 colab usage 登入；自訂節點 ComfyUI-H3-NativeAudioLock 從自己的 ComfyUI 複製到 assets/colab_nodes/（不進倉庫）。models 的鍵是 models/ 底下的相對路徑，unet、clip、video_vae、audio_vae 四個檔名都要在這裡有地址。2026-10-31 實測：開機 4 秒，裝 ComfyUI 加下載 42 GB 模型 169 秒（HF 約 300 MB/s），1024×576 一段 43–47 秒（3090 Ti 要 78–108 秒），費率 10.05 CCU/h，一支 5 段的片約 1.3 CCU；畫面跟 3090 Ti 版平均像素差 1.5–1.8/255，口型逐幀相關 0.99。max_minutes 是看守程序的強制關機上限，一支短片夠用，長片調高。Colab 條款禁止 deepfake，用真人照片當主播前先自己判斷。

tts.note: comfy 後端的配音：scripts/tts_generate.py 經 ssh 到這台 GPU 機器跑 CosyVoice 3（Fun-CosyVoice3-0.5B-2512）零樣本克隆，參考音檔是各主播的 tts_ref。2026-10-29 在 aikol（RTX 3090 Ti）試聽：比 VoxCPM2、IndexTTS-2.5、BlueMagpie-TTS 自然；用拼音強改平舌、本調反而刻意，所以台詞照原文送。ssh_host 是內網 aikol，環境變數 TTS_SSH_HOST 優先（在外面用 aiko）。路徑是那台機器上的，裝法見 references/install.md。

acts.full: warm eye contact, expressive face, natural hand gestures
acts.pip: calm explaining tone, small nods, occasionally glancing down as if reading a screen, small pointing gestures
acts.vlog: relaxed lifestyle vlogger sharing a favorite tool, natural small head tilts and nods, one hand comes up briefly in a casual gesture
acts.depth: medium shot with generous headroom and plain background visible on both sides of the head and shoulders (for text-behind-subject graphics), calm confident delivery

hands_rest: below the bottom edge of the frame, out of view

gestures.note: 手勢庫：script.json 每段可以寫 "gesture" 指定一種，沒寫的 full 段用 default，pip / vlog / depth 段沿用 acts。{hands_rest} 換成主播的 hands_rest（手平時放在哪裡，每位主播各寫一句）。來源是 awesome-talking-head-skills（MIT）拆的五位口播創作者：liyifan = 李一帆 L1 低位攤手、qiuzhi = 秋芝 Q1 揮手、muzi = 木子 M1 外攤、xiaolin = 小Lin說 X4 側掌、dashi = 大師 D1 抬手。qiuzhi / muzi / xiaolin 要雙手在畫面內的參考圖（例如坐在主播台後的中景），自拍構圖只用 liyifan / dashi。2026-10-30 H3 實拍（新聞棚中景，手放在桌上）：五種都沒崩手；放在段首的手勢時間點準，片中某一刻的手勢次數和長度不準（xiaolin 做了兩次，dashi 停 2 秒左右），所以一段只放一種，揮手、外攤放在開場段。xiaolin 原本寫「講到重點時睜大眼」、dashi 原本是「驚訝地睜大眼」，H3 會照字面瞪眼（眼高÷兩眼距離最高到 0.20，grok 約 0.14），2026-10-30 改成挑眉、眼睛保持平常大小，dashi 的驚訝換成會心一笑，重拍後降到 0.16。

styles.liyifan: warm smile and steady eye contact, the emotion carried by the face: eyebrows lift on questions, a brief squint on the last word of each sentence, small nods. Both hands are {hands_rest} the whole time. Only once, on a question or a key point, one hand lifts a little, palm up, for about half a second, then lowers again so both hands are {hands_rest}. No other hand gestures, no pointing
styles.qiuzhi: big warm smile and steady eye contact, small nods. At the start both hands rise beside the shoulders, palms facing the camera, fingers relaxed and together, and gently wave side to side twice as a greeting, then lower so both hands are {hands_rest}. After that both hands stay {hands_rest} with the elbows close to the body. No other hand gestures, no pointing
styles.muzi: smiling with raised eyebrows and steady eye contact. At the start both hands open outward from the chest to the sides, palms up and facing out, fingers naturally spread, wrists turning gently with the words for about two seconds, then lower so both hands are {hands_rest}. After that only a slight nod at the end of each phrase while both hands stay {hands_rest}. No other hand gestures, no pointing
styles.xiaolin: expressive face, eyebrows lift a little on key words while the eyes keep their relaxed natural size, leaning slightly forward. The left hand stays {hands_rest} the whole time. Once, while explaining, the right hand rises at the right side to chest height, palm facing inward and fingers together, moves in a small arc with the sentence for about one second, then lowers again so both hands are {hands_rest}. No other hand gestures, no pointing
styles.dashi: eyebrows slightly raised with a knowing, amused half-smile, the eyes keeping their relaxed natural size, clear mouth shapes, leaning slightly forward. Both hands are {hands_rest}. Once, on a key point, one hand rises to chest height, palm up, fingers relaxed and slightly curved, holds there for about half a second, then lowers again so both hands are {hands_rest}. No other hand gestures, no pointing

prompt_template:
The young woman in {ref} talks straight into her phone's front camera, same selfie framing, lighting and outfit as the reference, like a friendly Chinese tech vlogger {purpose}: {act}. Handheld selfie feel with only a very slight natural sway. She speaks Mandarin Chinese, clearly lip-synced, in {voice}:
“{line}”
Sound: only her voice and quiet room tone, no music, no subtitles, no on-screen text.
h3_prompt_template:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, a vertical selfie close-up frames the young woman shown in <Picture 1>, preserving her face, eye shape, long black hair with loose strands beside her face, white ribbed tank top, the selfie angle, the natural indoor light and the room behind her. She holds the phone at arm's length and the camera shakes slightly at slow speed, keeping the same selfie framing. Like a friendly Taiwanese tech vlogger {purpose}, she looks straight into the lens: {act}. The young woman with a friendly, clear and lively voice (S1) speaks {language} directly into the phone camera, her lips moving in sync with every syllable of her voice.

overall_soundscape: Quiet indoor room tone continues softly underneath her voice.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
h3_prompt_note: 2026-10-30 照 MiniMax 官方指南（MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 的 docs/VIDEO_PROMPT_WRITING_GUIDE_base_en.md）改寫，other_hosts 裡的 h3_prompt_template 也一樣：第一行 I2VA 指令、三個欄位（integrated_multimodal_description / overall_soundscape / non_diegetic_music）、說話的人標 (S1)、不寫否定句。畫面上的文字只在英文雙引號裡才會生成，所以台詞不放進模板。
